描述_EN: the inscription is taken from a newspaper caption. it reads: 'chairman mao on board a launch reviewing the swimmers who are battling the waves of the yangzi'. made to commemorate a famous swim by mao zedong, who was 73 at the time, in the yangzi river near wuhan on 16 july 1966. intended to underscore his vigour and health, the swim was given euphoric coverage in the press and was presented as an event of huge significance to the chinese people. during the years of the cultural revolution the factory produced many propaganda images based on portraits and photographs of leaders. woven silk pictures of the event were possibly produced to decorate swimming pools throughout china. this picture was made by the hangzhou dongfang hong ('east is red') factory, which has its roots as a factory pioneering the art of machine-woven pictures in china, using paintings and photographs.
描述_ZN: 碑文取自报纸的标题。 它写道： 毛泽东主席在船上检阅在扬子江上搏击风浪的游泳健儿"。 为纪念1966年7月16日73岁的毛泽东在武汉附近的扬子江中游泳而制作的。 意在强调他的活力和健康，媒体对这次游泳进行了兴奋的报道，并将其作为对中国人民具有巨大意义的事件。 在文化大革命时期，工厂生产了许多基于领导人肖像和照片的宣传图片。 这次活动的丝织品可能被用来装饰中国各地的游泳池。 这幅画是由杭州东方红厂制作的，该厂是中国机织画艺术的先驱，使用绘画和照片。
